x: George Lucas and Len Herbert had what was to them rather a disappointing season and we hope that a full season over the country will see them both fighting fit for next track season. Reg. Ruddick won the Surrey County 6 miles track title and should prove a great help to our teams when he is qualified to represent us.

…hes to Basil Walden, on B.O.A.C. duties in Tripoli; John Briggs and Jack Shields, now studying at Oxford University; to Reg. Ruddick, now qualified for our teams and eager to show his undoubted ability on our behalf; to our Chief Coach, George Clay, recently returned from hospital after an operation…
Bedford fourth and in the 2 miles Reg.

In the 3 miles championship, the holder, Len Herbert, was a non-starter and Vern Blowfield ran an excellent race to win in the new record time of 14 mins. 49.6 secs. Reg Ruddick was second and Len Marchant third with Eddie Short fourth. The following gained standard awards: 1st class, E.
Eddie Short won the 2 miles with Reg Ruddick third and we won the team race.

Reg. Ruddick carried on the good work and " clocked " 14min. 48secs. to further increase our lead and with Stan Davies doing 15min. 13secs. and Len Adams 15min. 9secs., Eddie Short went off on the fifth stage with a good lead.

Bill Lucas took the last leg and was unable to make much impression on the leader, Ellis of Aylesford, despite the fact that he ran the second fastest lap of the afternoon, and the Kent club were good winners by a margin of 24 seconds. Individual times of our men were: R.

…ur dropping off is partly explained when we find runners like Len Herbert, Derrick Burfitt, Bill Lucas, Frank Abberton, Reg Ruddick and Eddie Short not taking part in the big races and although we are a club of considerable numerical strength, it takes time to build up a really strong team.…
